=== HINT 1: Understanding Stacks and Queues ===

GOAL:
Implement two fundamental data structures:
  - Stack (LIFO - Last In, First Out)
  - Queue (FIFO - First In, First Out)

REAL WORLD EXAMPLES:

STACK (like a stack of plates):
  - Last plate put on top = first plate taken off
  - Undo history in text editors
  - Browser back button

QUEUE (like a queue at a store):
  - First person in line = first person served
  - Print queues
  - Task scheduling

THE OPERATIONS:

STACK:
  - push(item) → Add to top
  - pop() → Remove from top, return it
  - peek() → Look at top without removing
  - is_empty() → Check if empty
  - size() → How many items

QUEUE:
  - enqueue(item) → Add to back
  - dequeue() → Remove from front, return it
  - front() → Look at front without removing
  - is_empty() → Check if empty
  - size() → How many items

Still stuck? Read hint_2.txt
